title: Software Metering shows devices and app starts it used to hide
summary: A device could disappear from the Software Metering dashboard when Intune kept a separate collector result for a signed-in user. LicenseMeter now uses the device's newest result. App starts also show when the collector had to restart its coverage after a gap in the Windows event log: those starts are still real, while “App not started” waits for an uninterrupted period as before, and the device stays flagged under collection health.
